name: Sayorana Etranger
original_name: さよらなエトランジュ
source:
Main character is recovered from a frozen state after cure to his illness is discovered. As a result he loses his memories. He feels very lonely with no familiar face and being thrown 200 years in the future, but cheerful girl Haruka colors his world. Little by little he starts to open his heart to Haruka and with that acknowledges his position in this new world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在治愈疾病的方法问世后，主人公从冷冻状态中苏醒，却因此失去了记忆。熟悉的面孔一个也不在，自己还被抛到了200年后的未来，他感到无比孤独。但开朗的少女遥为他的世界染上了色彩。主人公一点点向遥敞开心扉，也逐渐接受了自己在这个新世界中的处境。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
